transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. We're here to finalize casting for the filmed stage thriller — we need to fill three roles: Mara Vale, the aerial lead; Tomas Reed, the speaking co-lead; and the Narrator. Our candidates are Alex Chen, Bea Okafor, and Cy Bell, with no one filling more than one role. Before I make the binding decision, I need to hear from the stunt, talent, and legal leads — please report any production requirements on your end.

transcript.text: I need to flag a stunt requirement. This certification result has not yet been added to the casting packet, so you may not have seen it.
